01. Block 100Name of the Land: Part of the Asst. No. of 449 in SunethiradeviRoad; Description: Marshy land; Claimant: State; OriginalClaimant: A. L. Senarathna, No. 449, Sunethiradevi Road,Pepiliyana; Extent: 0.0054 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land, are herebyrequired to appear personally or by agents duly authorized inwriting, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Kesbewa on the08.06.2018 at 9.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify tome in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 06th June 2018 thenature of their interests in the land, the particulars of theirclaims for compensation for the said land, the amount ofcompensation and the details of the computation of suchamount.
